description: This file defines the OverlapLeaveModel class, a data model representing leave overlap information in the HR management system. It extends LeaveModel and includes properties and methods for converting leave data related to overlapping leave requests into an array format suitable for API responses, including handling associated comments.

classes.name: OverlapLeaveModel
classes.description: A model class for representing overlapping leave entries, extending LeaveModel and adding specific handling for leave comments and data serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Leave entity, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the leave object to an array, including last comment details if available.
